direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh at 1366x768, overflow hidden; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; independent reserved zones for rendered scene, callouts, stations and jobs with no overlap; scene occupies at least 70% of main; side content condensed inside its reserved zone without inspector scrolling; all targets at least 36px, rail segments equal-width, non-wrapping, aria-current plus arrow-key movement
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald green and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); silver #C5CCD4 headings and machine bodies, rgba(197,204,212,.68) secondary text; emerald #A8F04A sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, x cross marker and plain OFFLINE text, never red; official logo immutable in black, emerald and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, no label under 12px; header tabs span most of the header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration
direction.motion: Living material flow, state glow, depth and cinematic transitions preserved; 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels, one 240ms route trace on real state change then static; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions and flow while silver pattern, x marker and OFFLINE text retain meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story retains the second required logo placement; compact horizontal rail only from one steps array; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene; side zone separates connection readiness checks for provider identity from the investigation evidence task under distinct headings, status and controls, never conflating them; selecting a recovery option opens one-click Approve then the Authorize this decision wall; a pending task proposal remains deliberately untracked until human approval and may coexist with blocked prior tasks and an approved recovery plan; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG enlarged to at least 70% of main from real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in emerald, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with x marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text
